Motion.Name: Animation motion
Motion.Hint: Reduced replaces movement, shaking and blinking with a short fade. The operating system preference is also respected.

Sound.Name: HUD sounds
Sound.Hint: Plays short synthesized sounds on intrusion events, at Foundry's interface volume.

Log.Name: Show event log
Log.Hint: Shows the run's log in your HUD, if the GM made it available. Also via the "Log" checkbox in the HUD header.

LogWorld.Name: Event log at the table
LogWorld.Hint: Makes the log panel available in the HUD for everyone. Each user chooses to show it (hidden by default).

Auto.Name: Mode without GM confirmation
Auto.Hint: Applies the result when the rules suggest one (DV, contest, damage) and rolls the Black ICE DEF/PER and hit damage without a dialog. Without a suggestion, the GM confirms. The Black ICE attack is still started by the GM. Requires a connected GM.

SeedIce.Name: Create the basic Black ICE in the world
SeedIce.Hint: The GM creates, in the "Black ICE (CNH)" folder, the sheets of the 12 basic Black ICE (actor and program) that do not exist yet. Sheets with the same name are reused.

Help.backdoor: Backdoor: breaks this node's Password (Interface + 1d10 vs DV). Once broken, you can go deeper. 1 NET Action.
Help.control: Control: takes over the Control Node (Interface + 1d10 vs DV). The GM narrates what it runs: cameras, doors, turrets… 1 NET Action.
Help.eyedee: Eye-Dee: identifies this node's file (Interface + 1d10 vs DV). The description is shown to the Netrunner. 1 NET Action.
Help.zap: Zap: basic attack (Interface + 1d10 vs the Black ICE's DEF or the enemy Netrunner's Defense). Hit: 1d6 damage. 1 NET Action.
Help.slide: Slide: escapes the Black ICE (Interface + 1d10 vs its PER). On success you are no longer stuck and can move. 1 NET Action.
Help.pathfinder: Pathfinder: maps the architecture (Interface + 1d10). Reveals floors below up to the total, stopping at a Password with a higher DV. 1 NET Action.
Help.cloak: Cloak: hides the Netrunner's traces (and virus). The total becomes the DV for anyone searching later. 1 NET Action.
Help.virus: Virus: lowest floor only. Leaves a virus that changes the architecture even after Jack Out; the GM sets the DV and effect. 1 NET Action.
Help.jackIn: Jack In: connects to the architecture at the first node. 1 NET Action.
Help.jackOut: Jack Out: disconnects safely. 1 NET Action.
Help.endTurn: Ends your turn now; the enemy's turn begins.
Help.passIce: Ends the enemy's turn; the Netrunner gets her NET Actions back.
Help.newTurn: New turn: the Netrunner's NET Actions recharge.
Help.rez: Rezzing turns the program on (Booster/Defender) and its effect lasts while on; derezzing turns it off. 1 NET Action each. Each copy activates once per round; Armor, Flak and Shield: one copy on at a time and once per Netrun.
Help.programAttack: Attacks the node's target with this program (Interface + ATK + 1d10 vs DEF + 1d10). Attackers turn off after use: each copy attacks once per round (Superglue, once per Netrun). 1 NET Action.
Help.iceAttack: The Black ICE attacks: ATK + 1d10 vs the Netrunner's Defense.
Help.npcZap: Enemy Netrunner's Zap: Interface + 1d10 vs the player's Defense; a hit deals 1d6 brain damage.
Help.npcProgram: The enemy Netrunner attacks with this program: ATK + 1d10 vs the player's Defense.
Help.initiative: Initiative: 1d10 + REF. Highest goes first; ties favor the player.
Help.recover: Neutralized (REZ 0): still installed, no effect. Derez (1 NET Action) and rez again (1 NET Action, next round if already activated this one) to come back with full REZ.

Editor.Armed: Click an empty cell to place: {type}
Editor.NoSelection: Click a node to configure it. Drag nodes to move them (dropping on another swaps both).
Editor.NoteHint: Only the GM sees it; the Netrunner sees it after beating the password or identifying the file.

Editor.NpcHint: Hidden until the Netrunner reaches the node.

Editor.Locked: Node in use by the active session
Editor.NpcLocked: During an active session, change the NPC from the session HUD.

Issue.no-root: Missing the floor 1, branch A node: that is where the Netrunner enters.
Issue.unreachable: {where}: no path to floor 1 (the floor above is missing in this branch or the previous one).

Editor.Restored: Unsaved draft restored ({time}). Save to keep it or discard to go back to the saved version.
Editor.DiscardHint: Goes back to the saved version and deletes the draft kept in this browser.
Editor.LockedConflict: The architecture is in use by an active session and the draft changed nodes in use ({nodes}). Discard or undo those changes to save.

Deck.Hint: Drag a program onto the deck to install it, or from the deck to here to uninstall. New programs come from the sheet (drag them from the Items tab onto the sheet).
Deck.NoActor: None of your characters has a cyberdeck. Add a cyberdeck to the sheet.
Deck.NoEquipped: No deck equipped: equip one to rez programs and Jack In.
Deck.MultipleEquipped: More than one deck equipped: the system uses the first. Equip only one.
Deck.Locked: Jacked into a run right now: the deck only changes through the session HUD (rezzing costs a NET action). After Jack Out it is editable here again.
Deck.WriteFailed: Could not save the cyberdeck. See the console (F12).

Help.install: Installs into the deck (uses slots). Free outside a run.
Help.uninstall: Removes from the deck and switches it off; the program stays on the sheet.
Help.rez: Switches the program on before Jack In, at full REZ. Free outside a run.
Help.derez: Switches the program off (a neutralized one can be rezzed again).
Help.equip: Equips this deck; the others are stowed and their programs switch off.

Error.destroyed: program destroyed: it does not come back
Error.state: the program is already in that state
Error.one-copy: a copy is already on (Armor, Flak and Shield: one at a time)

Deck.OpenFromHud: Open the cyberdeck (set up before Jack In)
Deck.GhostHint: Taken by an item that was deleted from the sheet (the system still counts it). Fix the deck from the sheet to free it.
Deck.PortIdle: Neural port free · ready to Jack In
Deck.PortLive: Neural port in use · jacked in
